subject: [PATCH v3 2/3] mm/huge_memory: don't queue folios when underused splitting is inactive

2026-10-23.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the handling of anonymous PMD-sized folios by skipping their queueing when underused splitting is inactive, which is the default case due to the maximum value of khugepaged/max_ptes_none. This change reduces unnecessary work and improves system performance. The patch introduces a new function thp_underused_never() that checks if underused splitting is never performed based on the sysctl value. It also updates the deferred_split_folio() function to use this new check. This optimization has implications for subsequent patches, including one that adds anonymous mTHP folios to the deferred split list.
